content:
Create a 30-second premium cinematic 3D animated comedy short film set inside a stylish modern South Asian family home.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, cinematic landscape, feature-film quality.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — HIGHEST PRIORITY:

Mom is a South Asian woman in her 40s with expressive facial reactions, wearing a modern modest casual home outfit.

Samatha is a young South Asian girl wearing a stylish modern casual outfit.

John is a young South Asian boy wearing a modern T-shirt/hoodie and joggers.

The youngest son is a young South Asian boy wearing modern casual clothes.

Grandma is an elderly South Asian woman wearing an elegant modern outfit and always sitting separately in her own comfortable armchair.

Keep every character’s face, hairstyle, age, body proportions, clothing, and identity consistent throughout every shot.

STYLE: Premium cinematic 3D animation, realistic stylized characters, highly detailed modern interiors, expressive facial animation, polished feature-film quality, cinematic lighting, realistic materials, smooth character movement, comedic timing, subtle depth of field and sophisticated color grading.

0–5s:
A stylish modern South Asian home with a spacious living room connected to a contemporary kitchen.

Mom is preparing food in the kitchen when she notices Samatha lying upside down across the sofa, completely absorbed in her phone.

Mom looks at her in disbelief.

Mom says: “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha briefly sits straight, then immediately returns to an even more ridiculous position.

Mom sighs dramatically and walks away.

5–10s:
Mom enters John’s separate bedroom.

John is sitting alone at his gaming PC, wearing large headphones and intensely playing a game.

John shouts: “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom calls: “John!”

He doesn’t hear her.

Mom calls louder: “JOHN!”

Still nothing.

John continues gaming.

Mom slowly looks directly into the camera with an exhausted deadpan expression.

10–14s:
Mom leaves the room and notices the youngest son coming downstairs.

He is holding his phone and doing exaggerated Michael Jackson-inspired dance moves while walking down the staircase.

He suddenly notices Mom and freezes.

He awkwardly smiles.

Youngest son says: “Hey, Mom.”

Mom just stares at him in complete disbelief.

14–19s:
Mom walks toward the Wi-Fi router with determination.

Close-up of her hand switching the router OFF.

CLICK.

Immediately show separate reaction shots of each child in their own location.

Samatha looks at her phone.

John removes one headphone.

The youngest checks his phone.

All three shout from different parts of the house:

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom crosses her arms.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s:
Mom returns to the kitchen and starts serving food.

A few seconds later, she notices something suspicious.

Samatha is secretly back on her phone.

John is gaming again.

The youngest is also using his phone.

Mom walks out of the kitchen.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

The camera slowly reveals Grandma sitting completely separately in her own elegant armchair.

She is casually holding her phone with her hotspot turned on.

Grandma gives a tiny innocent smile.

26–30s:
Mom looks at Grandma.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma casually shrugs.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

Everyone bursts into laughter.

Mom gives Grandma an exhausted look and walks back toward the kitchen.

End with a playful sitcom-style freeze frame and comedic music sting.

AUDIO: playful comedic background music, realistic household ambience, exaggerated comedic sound.

es.content:
Crea un cortometraje animado 3D cómico de 30 segundos, de estilo cinematográfico premium, ambientado dentro de una elegante casa familiar moderna del sur de Asia.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, cinematic landscape, feature-film quality.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — HIGHEST PRIORITY:

Mom es una mujer del sur de Asia de unos 40 años, con expresiones faciales muy marcadas, que lleva un atuendo moderno, modesto y casual para estar en casa.

Samatha es una niña joven del sur de Asia que lleva un conjunto casual moderno y con estilo.

John es un niño joven del sur de Asia que lleva una camiseta/hoodie moderna y joggers.

The youngest son is a young South Asian boy wearing modern casual clothes.

Grandma es una mujer mayor del sur de Asia que lleva un atuendo moderno y elegante y siempre está sentada aparte en su propio sillón cómodo.

Mantén consistentes la cara, el peinado, la edad, las proporciones corporales, la ropa y la identidad de cada personaje en cada plano.

STYLE: Premium cinematic 3D animation, realistic stylized characters, highly detailed modern interiors, expressive facial animation, polished feature-film quality, cinematic lighting, realistic materials, smooth character movement, comedic timing, subtle depth of field and sophisticated color grading.

0–5s:
Una elegante casa moderna del sur de Asia con una amplia sala de estar conectada a una cocina contemporánea.

Mom está preparando comida en la cocina cuando nota que Samatha está tumbada boca abajo sobre el sofá, completamente absorta en su teléfono.

Mom la mira incrédula.

Mom dice: “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha se sienta recta por un momento, y enseguida vuelve a una postura todavía más ridícula.

Mom suspira dramáticamente y se va.

5–10s:
Mom entra en el dormitorio independiente de John.

John está sentado solo frente a su PC gaming, con unos auriculares grandes, jugando intensamente.

John grita: “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom llama: “John!”

Él no la oye.

Mom llama más fuerte: “JOHN!”

Sigue sin pasar nada.

John continúa jugando.

Mom mira lentamente directamente a la cámara con una expresión agotada y completamente impasible.

10–14s:
Mom sale de la habitación y ve al hijo menor bajando las escaleras.

Está sosteniendo su teléfono y haciendo movimientos de baile exagerados inspirados en Michael Jackson mientras baja por la escalera.

De repente nota a Mom y se queda inmóvil.

Sonríe con incomodidad.

Youngest son dice: “Hey, Mom.”

Mom solo lo mira, completamente incrédula.

14–19s:
Mom camina con determinación hacia el router Wi‑Fi.

Primer plano de su mano apagando el router.

CLICK.

Mostrar inmediatamente planos de reacción separados de cada niño en su propia ubicación.

Samatha mira su teléfono.

John se quita uno de los auriculares.

El menor revisa su teléfono.

Los tres gritan desde distintas partes de la casa:

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom cruza los brazos.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s:
Mom vuelve a la cocina y empieza a servir la comida.

Unos segundos después, nota algo sospechoso.

Samatha ha vuelto a usar el teléfono a escondidas.

John está jugando otra vez.

El menor también está usando su teléfono.

Mom sale de la cocina.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

La cámara revela lentamente a Grandma sentada completamente aparte en su propio sillón elegante.

Está sosteniendo su teléfono con total naturalidad, con el hotspot activado.

Grandma esboza una pequeña sonrisa inocente.

26–30s:
Mom mira a Grandma.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma se encoge de hombros con calma.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

Todos estallan en carcajadas.

Mom le lanza a Grandma una mirada agotada y vuelve hacia la cocina.

Termina con un freeze frame juguetón al estilo sitcom y un remate musical cómico.

AUDIO: playful comedic background music, realistic household ambience, exaggerated comedic sound.

FORMAT : 16:9 grand écran, paysage cinématographique, qualité long-métrage.

COHÉRENCE DES PERSONNAGES — PRIORITÉ ABSOLUE :

Mom est une femme sud-asiatique d’une quarantaine d’années, avec des réactions faciales expressives, portant une tenue d’intérieur moderne, modeste et décontractée.

Samatha est une jeune fille sud-asiatique portant une tenue moderne, élégante et décontractée.

John est un jeune garçon sud-asiatique portant un T-shirt/hoodie moderne et un jogger.

Le plus jeune fils est un jeune garçon sud-asiatique portant des vêtements décontractés modernes.

Grandma est une femme sud-asiatique âgée portant une tenue moderne élégante et est toujours assise à part dans son propre fauteuil confortable.

Gardez le visage, la coiffure, l’âge, les proportions corporelles, les vêtements et l’identité de chaque personnage cohérents dans chaque plan.

STYLE : Animation 3D cinématographique premium, personnages stylisés réalistes, intérieurs modernes très détaillés, animation faciale expressive, qualité long-métrage soignée, éclairage cinématographique, matériaux réalistes, mouvements fluides des personnages, timing comique, légère profondeur de champ et étalonnage des couleurs sophistiqué.

0–5s :
Une maison sud-asiatique moderne et élégante avec un salon spacieux relié à une cuisine contemporaine.

Mom prépare à manger dans la cuisine lorsqu’elle remarque Samatha allongée à l’envers sur le canapé, complètement absorbée par son téléphone.

Mom la regarde, incrédule.

Mom dit : “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha s’assoit brièvement bien droite, puis reprend immédiatement une position encore plus ridicule.

Mom soupire dramatiquement et s’éloigne.

5–10s :
Mom entre dans la chambre séparée de John.

John est assis seul à son PC gaming, portant un gros casque audio et jouant intensément à un jeu.

John crie : “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom appelle : “John!”

Il ne l’entend pas.

Mom appelle plus fort : “JOHN!”

Toujours rien.

John continue de jouer.

Mom regarde lentement directement la caméra avec une expression épuisée et impassible.

10–14s :
Mom quitte la pièce et remarque le plus jeune fils qui descend les escaliers.

Il tient son téléphone et exécute des pas de danse exagérés inspirés de Michael Jackson en marchant dans l’escalier.

Il remarque soudain Mom et se fige.

Il esquisse un sourire gêné.

Le plus jeune fils dit : “Hey, Mom.”

Mom le fixe, complètement incrédule.

14–19s :
Mom marche avec détermination vers le routeur Wi-Fi.

Gros plan sur sa main qui éteint le routeur.

CLIC.

Montrez immédiatement des plans de réaction séparés de chaque enfant dans son propre endroit.

Samatha regarde son téléphone.

John retire un écouteur.

Le plus jeune regarde son téléphone.

Les trois crient depuis différents endroits de la maison :

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom croise les bras.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s :
Mom retourne dans la cuisine et commence à servir à manger.

Quelques secondes plus tard, elle remarque quelque chose de suspect.

Samatha est discrètement de nouveau sur son téléphone.

John rejoue.

Le plus jeune utilise aussi son téléphone.

Mom sort de la cuisine.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

La caméra révèle lentement Grandma, assise complètement à part dans son propre fauteuil élégant.

Elle tient nonchalamment son téléphone, avec son hotspot activé.

Grandma affiche un petit sourire innocent.

26–30s :
Mom regarde Grandma.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma hausse les épaules avec désinvolture.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

Tout le monde éclate de rire.

Mom lance à Grandma un regard épuisé et retourne vers la cuisine.

Terminez sur un freeze frame ludique de style sitcom et un sting musical comique.

AUDIO : musique de fond comique et ludique, ambiance domestique réaliste, sonorités comiques exagérées.

FORMAT: 16:9 와이드스크린, cinematic landscape, feature-film quality.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — HIGHEST PRIORITY:

Mom은 40대의 남아시아 여성으로, 표정 변화가 풍부하며 현대적이고 단정한 캐주얼 홈웨어를 입고 있다.

Samatha는 스타일리시한 현대 캐주얼 의상을 입은 어린 남아시아 소녀다.

John은 현대적인 T셔츠/후디와 조거 팬츠를 입은 어린 남아시아 소년이다.

The youngest son은 현대적인 캐주얼 옷을 입은 어린 남아시아 소년이다.

Grandma는 우아한 현대식 의상을 입은 노년의 남아시아 여성으로, 항상 자신의 편안한 안락의자에 따로 앉아 있다.

모든 샷에서 각 캐릭터의 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 나이, 체형 비율, 의상, 정체성을 일관되게 유지할 것.

STYLE: 프리미엄 cinematic 3D animation, realistic stylized characters, highly detailed modern interiors, expressive facial animation, polished feature-film quality, cinematic lighting, realistic materials, smooth character movement, comedic timing, subtle depth of field and sophisticated color grading.

0–5s:
세련된 현대식 남아시아 가정집, 넓은 거실이 현대적인 주방과 연결되어 있다.

Mom이 주방에서 음식을 준비하던 중, Samatha가 소파 위에 거꾸로 누워 휴대폰에 완전히 몰입해 있는 것을 발견한다.

Mom은 믿을 수 없다는 표정으로 그녀를 바라본다.

Mom이 말한다: “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha는 잠깐 바르게 앉았다가, 곧바로 더 황당한 자세로 돌아간다.

Mom은 과장되게 한숨을 쉬고 자리를 떠난다.

5–10s:
Mom이 John의 별도 침실로 들어간다.

John은 혼자 게임용 PC 앞에 앉아 대형 헤드폰을 끼고 게임에 완전히 몰입하고 있다.

John이 외친다: “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom이 부른다: “John!”

그는 듣지 못한다.

Mom이 더 크게 부른다: “JOHN!”

여전히 아무 반응이 없다.

John은 계속 게임을 한다.

Mom은 지친 무표정으로 천천히 카메라를 정면으로 바라본다.

10–14s:
Mom이 방을 나와 아래층으로 내려오는 youngest son을 발견한다.

그는 휴대폰을 들고 계단을 내려오면서 과장된 Michael Jackson 스타일의 춤 동작을 하고 있다.

그는 갑자기 Mom을 알아차리고 얼어붙는다.

어색하게 미소 짓는다.

Youngest son이 말한다: “Hey, Mom.”

Mom은 완전히 믿을 수 없다는 듯 그를 그저 바라본다.

14–19s:
Mom이 결연한 표정으로 Wi-Fi 라우터 쪽으로 걸어간다.

라우터를 끄는 Mom의 손 클로즈업.

CLICK.

즉시 각 아이들이 자기 위치에서 반응하는 개별 샷을 보여준다.

Samatha는 휴대폰을 바라본다.

John은 한쪽 헤드폰을 벗는다.

The youngest는 자신의 휴대폰을 확인한다.

세 사람 모두 집 안 각기 다른 곳에서 외친다:

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom은 팔짱을 낀다.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s:
Mom이 주방으로 돌아와 음식을 내기 시작한다.

몇 초 후, 그녀는 뭔가 수상한 점을 알아차린다.

Samatha가 몰래 다시 휴대폰을 보고 있다.

John은 다시 게임을 하고 있다.

The youngest도 역시 휴대폰을 사용하고 있다.

Mom이 주방 밖으로 걸어나온다.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

카메라는 천천히, 완전히 따로 떨어져 자신의 우아한 안락의자에 앉아 있는 Grandma를 드러낸다.

그녀는 핫스팟을 켠 채 휴대폰을 태연하게 들고 있다.

Grandma는 작고 순진한 미소를 짓는다.

26–30s:
Mom이 Grandma를 바라본다.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma는 태연하게 어깨를 으쓱한다.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

모두가 웃음을 터뜨린다.

Mom은 지친 표정으로 Grandma를 바라본 뒤 주방 쪽으로 다시 걸어간다.

장난스러운 sitcom 스타일의 freeze frame과 코믹한 음악 sting으로 마무리한다.

AUDIO: playful comedic background music, realistic household ambience, exaggerated comedic sound.
---

CONSISTÊNCIA DOS PERSONAGENS — MÁXIMA PRIORIDADE:

Mom é uma mulher sul-asiática na casa dos 40 anos, com reações faciais expressivas, vestindo uma roupa casual moderna e modesta para ficar em casa.

Samatha é uma jovem garota sul-asiática vestindo um look casual moderno e estiloso.

John é um jovem garoto sul-asiático vestindo uma camiseta/hoodie moderna e joggers.

Mantenha o rosto, o penteado, a idade, as proporções corporais, as roupas e a identidade de cada personagem consistentes em todas as cenas.

ESTILO: Animação 3D cinematográfica premium, personagens estilizados realistas, interiores modernos altamente detalhados, animação facial expressiva, qualidade polida de longa-metragem, iluminação cinematográfica, materiais realistas, movimento suave dos personagens, timing cômico, profundidade de campo sutil e color grading sofisticado.

0–5s:
Uma casa sul-asiática moderna e elegante, com uma sala de estar espaçosa conectada a uma cozinha contemporânea.

Mom está preparando comida na cozinha quando percebe Samatha deitada de cabeça para baixo no sofá, completamente absorta no celular.

Mom olha para ela incrédula.

Mom diz: “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha se senta ereta por um instante, depois imediatamente volta para uma posição ainda mais ridícula.

Mom suspira dramaticamente e vai embora.

5–10s:
Mom entra no quarto separado de John.

John está sentado sozinho no PC gamer, usando fones de ouvido grandes e jogando intensamente.

John grita: “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom chama: “John!”

Ele não a ouve.

Mom chama mais alto: “JOHN!”

Ainda nada.

John continua jogando.

Mom olha lentamente diretamente para a câmera com uma expressão exausta e impassível.

10–14s:
Mom sai do quarto e percebe o filho mais novo descendo as escadas.

Ele está segurando o celular e fazendo passos exagerados de dança inspirados em Michael Jackson enquanto desce a escada.

De repente, ele percebe Mom e congela.

Ele sorri sem jeito.

O filho mais novo diz: “Hey, Mom.”

Mom apenas encara, completamente incrédula.

14–19s:
Mom caminha com determinação até o roteador de Wi-Fi.

Close-up da mão dela desligando o roteador.

CLIQUE.

Mostre imediatamente reações separadas de cada criança em seu próprio local.

Samatha olha para o celular.

John tira um dos fones.

O mais novo verifica o celular.

Os três gritam de diferentes partes da casa:

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom cruza os braços.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s:
Mom volta para a cozinha e começa a servir a comida.

Alguns segundos depois, ela percebe algo suspeito.

Samatha está secretamente de volta no celular.

John está jogando novamente.

O mais novo também está usando o celular.

Mom sai da cozinha.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

A câmera revela lentamente Grandma sentada completamente separada em sua própria poltrona elegante.

Ela está segurando o celular casualmente, com o hotspot ligado.

Grandma dá um pequeno sorriso inocente.

26–30s:
Mom olha para Grandma.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma dá de ombros casualmente.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

Todos caem na gargalhada.

Mom lança para Grandma um olhar exausto e volta em direção à cozinha.

Termine com um freeze frame divertido no estilo sitcom e um sting musical cômico.

ÁUDIO: música de fundo cômica e divertida, ambiência realista de casa, som cômico exagerado.

创作一部 30 秒的高端电影感 3D 动画喜剧短片，场景设定在一座时尚现代的南亚家庭住宅内。

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, cinematic landscape, feature-film quality.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — HIGHEST PRIORITY:

Mom is a South Asian woman in her 40s with expressive facial reactions, wearing a modern modest casual home outfit.

Samatha is a young South Asian girl wearing a stylish modern casual outfit.

John is a young South Asian boy wearing a modern T-shirt/hoodie and joggers.

The youngest son is a young South Asian boy wearing modern casual clothes.

Grandma is an elderly South Asian woman wearing an elegant modern outfit and always sitting separately in her own comfortable armchair.

Keep every character’s face, hairstyle, age, body proportions, clothing, and identity consistent throughout every shot.

STYLE: Premium cinematic 3D animation, realistic stylized characters, highly detailed modern interiors, expressive facial animation, polished feature-film quality, cinematic lighting, realistic materials, smooth character movement, comedic timing, subtle depth of field and sophisticated color grading.

0–5s:
一座时尚现代的南亚家庭住宅，宽敞的客厅与现代厨房相连。

Mom is preparing food in the kitchen when she notices Samatha lying upside down across the sofa, completely absorbed in her phone.

Mom looks at her in disbelief.

Mom says: “Samatha! Can you sit like a normal girl for once?”

Samatha briefly sits straight, then immediately returns to an even more ridiculous position.

Mom sighs dramatically and walks away.

5–10s:
Mom enters John’s separate bedroom.

John is sitting alone at his gaming PC, wearing large headphones and intensely playing a game.

John shouts: “COME ON! GET HIM! GET HIM!”

Mom calls: “John!”

He doesn’t hear her.

Mom calls louder: “JOHN!”

Still nothing.

John continues gaming.

Mom slowly looks directly into the camera with an exhausted deadpan expression.

10–14s:
Mom leaves the room and notices the youngest son coming downstairs.

He is holding his phone and doing exaggerated Michael Jackson-inspired dance moves while walking down the staircase.

He suddenly notices Mom and freezes.

He awkwardly smiles.

Youngest son says: “Hey, Mom.”

Mom just stares at him in complete disbelief.

14–19s:
Mom walks toward the Wi-Fi router with determination.

Close-up of her hand switching the router OFF.

CLICK.

Immediately show separate reaction shots of each child in their own location.

Samatha looks at her phone.

John removes one headphone.

The youngest checks his phone.

All three shout from different parts of the house:

“Mom! WHY?!”

Mom crosses her arms.

“If you don't put your phones down and eat your food… NO INTERNET.”

19–26s:
Mom returns to the kitchen and starts serving food.

A few seconds later, she notices something suspicious.

Samatha is secretly back on her phone.

John is gaming again.

The youngest is also using his phone.

Mom walks out of the kitchen.

“The Wi-Fi is OFF. How are you guys online?!”

The camera slowly reveals Grandma sitting completely separately in her own elegant armchair.

She is casually holding her phone with her hotspot turned on.

Grandma gives a tiny innocent smile.

26–30s:
Mom looks at Grandma.

“I knew it! You gave them your hotspot. They’re literally buying your love!”

Grandma casually shrugs.

“So what? I’m selling it.”

Everyone bursts into laughter.

Mom gives Grandma an exhausted look and walks back toward the kitchen.

End with a playful sitcom-style freeze frame and comedic music sting.

AUDIO: playful comedic background music, realistic household ambience, exaggerated comedic sound.
